name: NaughtyNice Cloud
author: Joseph Jarboe (jjarboe01)
description: Shows visitor submissions from the NaughtyNice Cloud service (naughtynicefpp.com) on your matrix: a child's first name, a naughty/nice verdict and an optional photo. Outbound-only polling; photos are deleted from this device once shown.

privacy.summary: Polls naughtynicefpp.com for visitor submissions (a child's first name, naughty/nice verdict and optional photo) and shows them on your display.

sends.what: Your plugin token and whether each submission was shown
sends.why: Fetch queued submissions and confirm delivery
Show connection status in your NaughtyNiceFPP dashboard

collects.what: Child's first name, naughty/nice verdict and photo from a visitor's submission

systemChanges.what: Runs a background daemon (nnl_daemon.py) while fppd is running
Installs requests and Pillow from PyPI into a plugin venv, and the fonts-dejavu-core apt package if it is missing
Creates PhotoZone/TickerZone Pixel Overlay Models and a breaking-news playlist; copies nnl_display_image.py into FPP's scripts folder
Sets FPP's restart or reboot flag when you click Request FPPD restart / Request reboot on the setup page

privacy.other: Visitors submit on naughtynicefpp.com, which holds each submission (and its photo) only until it is delivered or expires. Uninstall removes the plugin's data.
